questions.question: How should the two remaining resample-uv differences be handled: one bilinear value off by one code (a float32 near-tie), and bilinear minification (scale 3.3) that Painter prefilters?
questions.context: Every other Tier 0 set of this task is exact on CPU and GPU (parity/reports/phase1/compositor-sources-projection.md). In resample-uv, BilinearHQ/BilinearSharp with Repeat differ in exactly one value of 1 376 256 per set (s0 and s1, User2, texel (175,18) green, |delta| 1, both recordings): the exact weighted sum of float32 texels lies 2^-34.7 above a float32 midpoint and Painter rounded down; no tested variant (sum truncation 26-41 bits, texel conversions, summation orders) fixes it without breaking hundreds of others. Separately, User6 (field A at scale 3.3, minification) under the bilinear filters is a wider prefilter Painter applies that phase0.7 could not fit (resampling.json gap); the evaluator refuses it explicitly with evaluator:unsupported_source. Decision 017 says a divergence passes only through an owner-approved exception.

options.label: Exception + release gap
options.description: approve a versioned exception for the one near-tie value (evidence in uv-sampling.json) and list bilinear minification as a release gap of a follow-up task; archive phase1.8

options.label: Keep open
options.description: leave 3.3/4.1 open until a follow-up fit reproduces both; phase1.8 stays unarchived

options.label: Split
options.description: archive phase1.8 now and move both items into a new follow-up task (bilinear near-tie and minification prefilter)

questions.blocks: 3.3 Tier 0 UV filter/wrap/transform goldens and `BilinearHQ` resampling goldens exact (and 4.1)
questions.answer: Coordinator (2026-10-11): Split. Archive this task with the exact sets; move the two resample-uv differences (Bilinear+Repeat one-code near-tie in s0/s1 User2; Bilinear minification at scale 3.3 with Painter's pre-filter, currently refused as evaluator:unsupported_source) into a new follow-up task that stays open until both match exactly or the owner approves an exception-register entry (decision 017). Nothing is accepted as a pass here.
